notes.title: 伊娃迎来重大更新！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645102/9065e7cbbf72275e315d1424de70af9ee2d28ff5.png[/img]

According to your feedback and some deficiencies in the game, we made a major update and adjustment!



Note that the old save is not available, just start a new game!



1 Update some new maps and adjust some original map layouts.

2 Update and adjust the trip encounter event.

3 Customize keys. Add the Enter key to enable the customization key input.

4 Add a medium BOSS encounter map.

5 Update Modified shots no longer reduce stamina.

6 Update added the number of one-time trap item placement to four.

7 Update When encountering NPCS, you can have multiple options to talk to each other, and determine whether you are damaged according to character attributes.

8 Rich trip encountered events. In the travel brand, it can be obtained after mouse click, UAV supply, random treasure chest, and so on.

9 Add three new mechanisms in the room.

10 Fixed and adjusted the inconsistency between some weapon attributes and name, and adjusted the weapon attributes accordingly.

11 At the end of the battle map, add game tips.

12 Tweaks to speed up zombie tracking on the trip.



Thank you all for your support of Eva!

notes.title: EVA: FINAL MISSION was updated on October 8th, and 9 items were optimized and im
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. After a week of the game's release, we have seen a lot of feedback and suggestions. We will adjust the content of the game as soon as possible after collecting them. Hope to bring you a better experience, hope you have fun.

[B] In particular, due to the problem of the development tool engine, which involves the update of game data, we need to delete the archive to maintain the game content. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to you. Previously saved game saves are invalid. [/b]



Here are the updates to the game:

1. Added knapsack button to the road walking interface to support viewing of equipped weapons and sub-weapons.

2. Points and talents are supported in combat, and the class talent icon button is displayed on the battle interface.

3. Walking and fighting, reduce the energy consumption, the energy value is 0, the new prompt copy, need to stand still rest to restore energy.

4. Increased weapon resources in Normal difficulty opening. (increased melee focus)

5. Switch the Chinese UI and change the English UI to Chinese.

6. You can roll without physical strength. Each roll costs 3 health points.

7. Increase the default consumption time of UAV turrets.

8. Due to the update of the game, the save will be invalid, as a compensation, automatically send level 2 characters with 300 gold, only in normal mode.

9. Many weapons share one tile, have removed strange wrong names.
